FINDING (high, security): CLI `what-now --format json` still emits an unsanitized legacy guidance surface alongside the ActionItem envelope. Evidence: `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/cli.py` builds `payload = guidance.to_dict()` and only appends scrubbed `action_items`; my reproduction showed `legacy_secret_leaks=True`, `legacy_brand_leaks=True`, while `action_items_secret_leaks=False`. Recommendation: make the JSON surface render from `action_renderers.render_cli_what_now(action_items, fmt="json")`, or remove/scrub/brand-normalize every legacy field before output.
